format: one COCO image id (integer) per line, in the question_id order of the source file

source.readme_statement: LiM README: the CHAIR test set is chair-500.jsonl, randomly sampled from the MSCOCO validation set with random seed 0
source.also_used_by: HALVA README (github.com/pritamqu/HALVA): "We use the same 500 images ... as used in prior work" (links this file)

derivation: image "%012d.jpg" -> int; order kept; question_id checked to be 0..n-1
question_text_values: Please describe this image in detail.

coco_check.note: E1 (and CHAIR) drop images without instance annotations at scoring time; decoding uses all ids
